answer_1.quote: Sentence fusion aims to combine several related sentences into a single coherent text. It is important in many NLP tasks such as text summarization, question answering and retrieval-based dialogue.

answer_2.quote: We adopt ROUGE F1 as the basic evaluation metric. We also apply FactCC... we also report the results of another two metrics, including (1) fusion rate (Fus) ... and (2) length (Len).

answer_4.quote: We further conduct human evaluation to analyze unfaithful errors and fusion quality. We randomly extract 50 samples ... and invite three fluent English speakers as human judges. Given a sentence fusion instance, the judges are asked to answer yes or no to ... (1) Fluency ... (2) Fusion ... (3) Faithful.
answer_4.guideline: Judges answer yes/no to three questions: Fluency, Fusion, Faithful.
